subject: a small, short British queen of the 19th century with light brown hair parted in the centre and smoothed into a low bun, a round face and pale blue eyes, wearing a modest high-necked silk gown of the period

panels.01-kensington: a red-brick English palace with tall windows set in quiet green gardens in London in 1819, a nursemaid in a bonnet carrying a baby in white lace along a gravel path, soft morning light, wide establishing shot, early 19th century
panels.02-journal: a thirteen-year-old English princess in a simple 1830s day dress with her hair in a neat bun, writing carefully in a small leather-bound journal at a window seat inside a travelling carriage, Welsh hills passing outside, 1832
panels.03-accession: a young eighteen-year-old version of {S}, standing alone in a plain morning gown with a shawl over her shoulders in a palace sitting room at dawn in 1837, an elderly archbishop in black and a court official kneeling to kiss her hand, candlelight and pale window light, solemn turning point
panels.04-wedding: a young {S} in a white satin wedding gown with a lace veil and a crown of orange blossom, standing beside a young prince with dark hair and side whiskers in a red British field marshal's uniform, inside a small royal chapel with a painted ceiling, London 1840, dignified and joyful
panels.05-exhibition: one single young queen, {S}, alone in the foreground, opening the Great Exhibition of 1851 inside the vast glass-and-iron Crystal Palace in Hyde Park, a crystal fountain and tall elm trees under the glass roof, crowds of visitors in 1850s dress behind her, Prince Albert in a dark coat at her side, only one queen in the scene
panels.06-valour: {S} on horseback in a dark riding habit and plumed hat, leaning down to pin a small bronze cross medal on the coat of a common soldier in red Crimean War uniform, a line of soldiers and sailors waiting in Hyde Park in 1857, crowds behind, proud and respectful
panels.07-highlands: an older {S} in a black silk mourning dress with a small white lace widow's cap with long streamers at the back of her head (not a nun's veil, no wimple), writing in her journal at a table by a window at Balmoral castle in the 1860s, Scottish hills outside, tartan cloth on a chair, quiet and steady
panels.08-jubilee: an elderly {S} with white hair in a black dress and small white cap holding a parasol, seated in an open state carriage drawn by cream horses outside a great domed London cathedral in 1897, cheering crowds, soldiers from many lands in dress uniform lining the street, flags and garlands
